header.title: Intensity
header.description: Effect strength. The `intensity` prop takes a token (`sm`, `md` or `lg`) or a number between `0` and `1`. Tokens are also available as `--gemfx-intensity-*` variables.

scale.title: Tokens
scale.description: Each swatch mixes the accent color with transparent at the token percentage.

custom.title: Custom values
custom.description: A number between `0` and `1` becomes a mix percentage. For values that are not percentages (blur, scale, distance), effects interpolate between the value of each token with `mixIntensity`.

tester.title: Try a value
tester.description: Move the slider to see what the helpers return. `mixIntensity` uses an example blur of 8, 16 and 28 px for `sm`, `md` and `lg`.
tester.label: intensity

items.intensity: Value of each token as a unit between `0` and `1`.
items.intensityCss: Value of each token as a CSS percentage.
items.isIntensityToken: Tells whether a value is `sm`, `md` or `lg`.
items.clampIntensityUnit: Clamps a number to `0`–`1`. Non-finite values return the `md` value.
items.intensityUnit: Turns a token or a number into a unit between `0` and `1`.
items.intensityCssValue: Turns a token or a number into a percentage (`0.62` → `62%`).
items.mixIntensity: Linear interpolation across a per-token map. `0` returns `at0` (default `0`), tokens return their value and `1` extrapolates past `lg`.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: In CSS, use the variables as a mix percentage. On effects, pass a token or a number to `intensity`.

code.mix: your own value that scales with intensity
